summary: The implementation satisfies the saved artifact read/download API plan: it adds a safe artifact service, preserves the existing cursor-ready metadata envelope, exposes a token-protected download endpoint under /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/artifacts/download, serves bytes only from the managed workspace artifact root, rejects traversal, absolute, empty, backslash, symlink-file, and symlink-directory paths, returns structured missing-workspace and missing-artifact errors without host path leakage, sets download length/type/disposition headers, and documents the client-facing API and safety constraints. Validation passed: focused artifact API/service/runtime tests, ruff, and mypy.
